text: The legal name must be identical on every document submitted for the client. Any variation in spelling or a different name on any document is a mismatch and must go to a human reviewer.
title: Name consistency across documents

text: The company registration number (CIN) must match across the incorporation certificate and any other document that states it. A different registration number means the documents may belong to different entities.
title: Registration number consistency

text: The registered / residential address must be consistent across all documents. A different address on any document must be flagged for review.
title: Address consistency across documents

text: An identity document (Aadhaar, passport, driving licence) that has passed its expiry date is not valid proof of identity. An expired ID is a critical failure: propose rejection and let a human confirm.
title: ID document must not be expired

text: Address proof (utility bill, bank statement) must be dated within the last 90 days. Older proof may not reflect the client's current address.
title: Address proof must be recent

text: An individual must submit ID proof and address proof. A company must submit its certificate of incorporation, a director's ID proof, and address proof. A case cannot pass through until every required document is present.
title: All required documents must be present

text: The date of incorporation on the certificate must be on or before today. A future incorporation date is impossible and must be flagged.
title: Incorporation date must be valid

text: The registration number on the documents must match the number the client declared on the onboarding application form. A mismatch means the wrong entity's documents were submitted.
title: Registration number must match the application

text: The address on the documents must match the address the client declared on the onboarding application form.
title: Address must match the application

text: Every uploaded document must be identifiable as an ID proof, incorporation papers, or address proof. A document the agent cannot classify must go to a human reviewer.
title: Every document must be classifiable
